name: Package Courier may discard a card to draw a card on enter
notes: Package Courier's element is FIRE, matching the starting champion, so no lineage patch is needed. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 2-reserve cost is paid; the ability's own MZMAYCHOOSE discard decision appears directly after the last reserve payment with no separate opportunity-window PASS needed. Discarding a hand card draws a replacement card (net hand size unchanged, but graveyard grows and a new card is drawn from the deck).

rulesClauses: On Enter: You may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
